subsystems.name: Display system
subsystems.role: presents a separate high-resolution image to each eye.

subsystems.name: Optical system
subsystems.role: magnifies the tiny displays and makes them comfortable to view.

subsystems.name: Sensor suite
subsystems.role: tracks the user's eyes, hands and the surrounding room.

subsystems.name: Compute and power
subsystems.role: fuses sensor data and renders graphics in real time.

subsystems.name: Audio system
subsystems.role: provides spatial sound and captures the user's voice.

subsystems.name: Enclosure and ergonomics
subsystems.role: houses the components and distributes weight for comfort.

buildSteps.title: Design and simulate the optics and sensors
buildSteps.detail: Engineers use optical ray-tracing and electromagnetic simulation to place lenses, displays and cameras within millimetres.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate the micro-OLED displays
buildSteps.detail: Organic light-emitting layers are deposited on a silicon backplane, then the panel is sealed and tested for defects.

buildSteps.title: Manufacture the pancake lenses
buildSteps.detail: Precision moulding and multi-layer coating create thin, lightweight lenses that fold the light path.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the sensor modules
buildSteps.detail: Cameras, LiDAR and eye-tracking sensors are built and aligned to sub-degree tolerances.

buildSteps.title: Build the compute board
buildSteps.detail: Processors, memory and power management chips are surface-mounted onto a dense printed circuit board.

buildSteps.title: Integrate the headset
buildSteps.detail: Displays, optics, sensors, board and audio components are fitted into the chassis and connected.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate and test
buildSteps.detail: Each unit is calibrated for display uniformity and sensor alignment, then run through software and stress tests.
